build.beforeDevCommand: npm run tauri:prepare-sidecar:dev && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run tauri:prepare-sidecar && npm run renderer:build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* https:; img-src 'self' data: blob: http: https: asset:; media-src 'self' data: blob: http: https: asset:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'
